SHENSHEN-FORM_POWER.title: Girl Form
SHENSHEN-FORM_POWER.description: Use your girl deck. You cannot play Cat cards. Transformation preserves HP, Energy, Block, and other powers.
SHENSHEN-FORM_POWER.catDescription: Use your cat deck. You cannot play Girl cards. Transformation preserves HP, Energy, Block, and other powers.
SHENSHEN-FORM_POWER.smartDescription: Transforming discards the old form's exclusive hand cards and draws the same number from the new form. Preserve HP, Energy, Block and powers.
SHENSHEN-FORM_SHIFT_POWER.title: Transformation Echo
SHENSHEN-FORM_SHIFT_POWER.description: Claw Strike hits 4 times this turn.
SHENSHEN-FORM_SHIFT_POWER.smartDescripti: Claw Strike hits 4 times this turn.
SHENSHEN-LIGHT_MARK_POWER.title: Light Mark
SHENSHEN-LIGHT_MARK_POWER.description:
Each attack hit from the applier adds {BurnDamage} burn damage. {Turns} of their turns remain.
Burn can be blocked and is not affected by Strength, Weak, or Vulnerable.
SHENSHEN-LIGHT_MARK_POWER.smartDescripti: Each attack hit from the applier adds fixed burn damage. Burn can be blocked and is not affected by Strength, Weak, or Vulnerable.
SHENSHEN-LIGHT_BLESSING_POWER.title: Light Blessing
SHENSHEN-LIGHT_BLESSING_POWER.descriptio: Before your next normal draw, choose {Amount} extra cards from your draw pile to add to hand.
SHENSHEN-LIGHT_BLESSING_POWER.smartDescr: Before your next normal draw, choose extra cards from your draw pile to add to hand.
SHENSHEN-LIGHT_BLESSING_POWER.selectionS: Choose {Amount} extra cards to add to hand.
SHENSHEN-CAT_DODGE_POWER.title: Mew Dodge
SHENSHEN-CAT_DODGE_POWER.description: This turn, while in Cat Form, dodge the first hit of the first enemy multi-hit attack.
SHENSHEN-CAT_DODGE_POWER.smartDescriptio: This turn, while in Cat Form, dodge the first hit of the first enemy multi-hit attack.
SHENSHEN-FLUFFED_UP_POWER.title: Fluffed Up
SHENSHEN-FLUFFED_UP_POWER.description: After activation, the first enemy attack hit that causes HP loss grants 3 Thorns.
SHENSHEN-FLUFFED_UP_POWER.smartDescripti: After activation, the first enemy attack hit that causes HP loss grants 3 Thorns.
SHENSHEN-FLUFFED_UP_POWER.upgradedDescri:
After activation, the first enemy attack hit that causes HP loss grants 3 Thorns. Each later hit that causes HP loss grants 1.
Each successful enemy debuff application grants 1 Thorns.
SHENSHEN-SHATTERED_MIRROR_POWER.title: Shattered Mirror
SHENSHEN-SHATTERED_MIRROR_POWER.descript: {Amount} of your Block reflects the attack damage it blocks. This Block is consumed first. The reflection effect expires at the start of your next turn.
SHENSHEN-SHATTERED_MIRROR_POWER.smartDes: Block affected by this effect reflects the attack damage it blocks and is consumed first. The reflection effect expires at the start of your next turn.
SHENSHEN-TEMPORARY_DEXTERITY_POWER.title: Temporary Dexterity
SHENSHEN-TEMPORARY_DEXTERITY_POWER.descr: Lose this {Amount} Dexterity at the start of your next turn.
SHENSHEN-TEMPORARY_DEXTERITY_POWER.smart: Temporary Dexterity expires at the start of your next turn.
SHENSHEN-TEMPORARY_THORNS_POWER.title: Temporary Thorns
SHENSHEN-TEMPORARY_THORNS_POWER.descript: Lose this {Amount} Thorns at the start of your next turn.
SHENSHEN-TEMPORARY_THORNS_POWER.smartDes: Temporary Thorns expires at the start of your next turn.
SHENSHEN-CURIOUS_PEEK_POWER.title: Curious Echo
SHENSHEN-CURIOUS_PEEK_POWER.description: After your next transformation this turn, draw {Amount} extra card(s).
SHENSHEN-CURIOUS_PEEK_POWER.smartDescrip: Draw extra cards after your next transformation this turn.

SHENSHEN-LIGHT_RESERVE_POWER.title: Light Reserve
SHENSHEN-LIGHT_RESERVE_POWER.description: The first time you fully Block an enemy attack each turn, gain {Amount} Strength.
SHENSHEN-LIGHT_RESERVE_POWER.smartDescri: The first time you fully Block an enemy attack each turn, gain Strength.
SHENSHEN-MIRROR_AFTERGLOW_POWER.title: Mirror Afterglow
SHENSHEN-MIRROR_AFTERGLOW_POWER.descript: The first time you reflect damage each turn, gain {Amount} Energy next turn.
SHENSHEN-MIRROR_AFTERGLOW_POWER.smartDes: The first time you reflect damage each turn, gain extra Energy next turn.
SHENSHEN-LIGHT_SHADOW_HANDOFF_POWER.desc: After your next transformation this turn, gain {Amount} Block.
SHENSHEN-LIGHT_SHADOW_HANDOFF_POWER.smar: After your next transformation this turn, gain Block.
SHENSHEN-MIRRORED_VESTMENTS_POWER.title: Mirrored Vestments
SHENSHEN-MIRRORED_VESTMENTS_POWER.descri: Each turn, up to {Amount} Block from your first Skill that grants Block reflects the attack damage it blocks. This does not grant additional Block.
SHENSHEN-MIRRORED_VESTMENTS_POWER.smartD: Each turn, some Block from your first Skill that grants Block reflects the attack damage it blocks. This does not grant additional Block.
SHENSHEN-WARDING_PRAYER_POWER.title: Warding Prayer
SHENSHEN-WARDING_PRAYER_POWER.descriptio: After each of your first 3 attack hits each turn, gain {Amount} Block, unaffected by Dexterity. Multi-hit attacks trigger this per hit; an attack against multiple targets triggers it once per hit.
SHENSHEN-WARDING_PRAYER_POWER.smartDescr: Gain Block after each of your first 3 attack hits each turn, unaffected by Dexterity. Multi-hit attacks trigger this per hit; an attack against multiple targets triggers it once per hit.
SHENSHEN-INSIGHT_CHARM_POWER.title: Insight Charm
SHENSHEN-INSIGHT_CHARM_POWER.description: Your next Girl Skill this turn costs {Amount} less Energy.

SHENSHEN-GUARD_THE_BELLY_POWER.descripti: After the next enemy attack hits you, regain the Block it consumed, up to {Amount}, unaffected by Dexterity. If unused, expires at the start of your next turn.
SHENSHEN-GUARD_THE_BELLY_POWER.smartDesc: Regain some consumed Block after the next enemy attack, unaffected by Dexterity. If unused, expires at the start of your next turn.
SHENSHEN-BIG_STRETCH_POWER.title: Temporary Strength
